description: Create a new MODULE under the connected project. Set `isRoot:true` for a top-level folder; otherwise pass `parentId` (resolve via list_modules). To create a WHOLE HIERARCHY in one call (root + submodules + nested submodules), pass a `children` array — each child gets `isRoot:false` and its parentId auto-wired from the tree position (do NOT set `isRoot`/`parentId` on child nodes). Duplicate name in the same project is rejected server-side. On mid-subtree failure the response carries `failedAt`; every node before it is already persisted (no transactional rollback upstream). SimplifyQA-only. Requires a live connection.

children.description: Optional subtree under this module. Each child = { name, description?, children? } — no isRoot/parentId (derived).

isRoot.description: True → top-level folder; false → child of `parentId`.

name.description: Module name. Must be unique within the project.

parentId.description: Parent module id (required when isRoot is false; MUST be omitted when isRoot is true).

name: create_module
title: Create a module (folder), optionally with a nested subtree, in the test-case tree
